title: Montrose Bowl
specs: Kids need to wear white-soled tennis/athletic shoes
Extra charge of $250 for 2 hours for parties over 50 people to make venue fully private
includes: All 8 lanes, party room, shoes, bumpers upon request
blurb: Guests can rent all 8 bowling lanes for parties and events with options for additional hours and private venue for large groups. The venue offers a plant-based menu including sandwiches, burgers, fries, and catering options. Shoes and bumpers are provided upon request for bowling.
extraNote: Deposit of 50% of rental fee required to book a party · Outside catering subject to additional fee · All beverages must be purchased from Montrose Bowl · Client responsible for guest behavior and damages; credit card on file charged for damages · Guests not permitted to walk on bowling lanes at any time · Montrose Bowl may refuse service or shut down lanes for inappropriate behavior · No refund if one lane breaks; prorated refund if two or more lanes go down not from misuse · Holiday prices add $150 per hour Thanksgiving weekend and Dec 10–31
